$comment: Transcribed from Canva card images provided 2026-07-15, plus the full 'ABCDEF Cards' Google Drive folder pulled the same day. Where a character had multiple Drive file revisions (Ken, Li-Ola, Skylle Heavy Neo Bird Mode), the most-recently-created file was treated as canonical per user direction; see per-card _note fields for details on what differed between revisions. Cards without visible move-color badges in the source text (most non-Character card types) omit the `color` field pending confirmation against the actual images.

cards.name: Kenjto

moves.name: Parkour Light Step
moves.text: The next 2 enemy turns -50 from damage.

moves.name: Shadow Kick
moves.text: Flip a coin 6x. Does 25 times the number of heads and 10 the number of tails.

moves.name: Myst Cap Cannon
moves.text: Does 0 in Low Myst, 100 in Medium Myst and 200 in High Myst. (-10 from Ken's Life)

cards.ability: Myst level is low, no boost. Myst level is medium, +50 to Life and +10 Defense. If the Myst level is high, then +150 to Life, -10 to Defense, and +25 to move number 2.
cards.flavorText: Ken, a Human ESU from Tokyo Japan

cards.name: Skylle

moves.name: Clear Eyes, Full Heart
moves.text: Wait 1 turn. Next attack does +50.

moves.name: Angel Riffle
moves.text: Does 75 to one enemy.

moves.name: Air Renzo-Zuken
moves.text: Flip a coin. Does 25 x the number of Heads. Flip 6 times.

cards.flavorText: Capheru Skylle Haven. A.N.G.E.L.S. of the Holy Nublian Empire

cards.name: Wilhelm

moves.name: Giant War Hammer Smash
moves.text: Wait 1 turn. Next turn does 200 to one enemy and -100 to Wilhelm's Life.

moves.name: Ngombe Ngulu Cut
moves.text: Roll a d6 or d10. If the player rolls an even number, 100 to all enemies; if odd number, 150 to one enemy.

moves.name: Dodge and Counter
moves.text: One enemy card loses 2 turns. During the player's next 2 turns Wilhelm's attacks are +100, and on the final turn his attack is +200.

cards.ability: Roll a d6 or a d10. If the player rolls a 4 or a 10, they can summon the Coffin. If the summon is successful, Wilhelm and the Coffin each lose 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: Wilhelm von Kovář, the 9th Ranked VixTen Commander

cards.name: Independence Dragon

moves.name: Dragon Fireworks
moves.text: Wait 1 turn, then 300 to one enemy.

moves.name: Red, White and Doom
moves.text: Wait 2 turns; on the 3rd turn, 500 to all enemies.

moves.name: Grand Finale
moves.text: Wait 3 turns. On the 4th turn, heal Independence Dragon by 200 and then do 700 to all enemies.

cards.ability: Myst levels have no effect on Independence Dragon. If fighting another dragon, subtract 100 from starting Defense.
cards.flavorText: Fireworks celebrating independence? Why disturb my slumber?

cards.name: Skylle

moves.name: Clear Eyes, Full Heart
moves.text: Wait 1 turn. Next attack does +60.

moves.name: Angel Riffle
moves.text: Does 85 to one enemy. Ignore Defense.

moves.name: Air Renzo-Zuken
moves.text: Flip a coin 6x. Does 35 x the number of Heads.

cards.name: Skylle Heavy Neo Bird Mode

moves.name: Vulcan Strike
moves.text: Target 1 enemy, does 100 + their full Defense at start of fight.

moves.name: Air Raid
moves.text: Wait 1 turn. Does 175 to all enemies.

moves.name: Air Superiority
moves.text: If fighting an enemy that is using an Item or Weapon card, +30 to all attacks.

cards.flavorText: Skylle's Heavy Neo Bird Mode
cards._note: Two Drive revisions existed; used the one including move 3 'Air Superiority' (later createdTime) per 'newest file wins.' Move colors not visible in source text extraction — confirm against the card image.

cards.name: Wilhelm's Coffin

moves.name: Drunken Bones
moves.text: The player of this card loses 1 turn.

moves.name: Skeleton Dash
moves.text: Wilhelm only. Wait 4 turns; on the 5th turn does 200 to all enemies plus an action from Wilhelm.

cards.ability: Once this card is played, the next 2 enemy character cards that Wilhelm defeats, instead of going to the opposing Graveyard, are converted into Skeleton cards for the player of this card and can be used on the BF as their own. If defeated, they go back to the opposing Graveyard. If Wilhelm is defeated, this card's effect is cancelled.
cards.flavorText: The Coffin Monk's Summon
cards._note: Printed card type is Weapon but flavor text calls it a Summon — confirm intended card type.

cards.name: Godiva

moves.name: Soul Eye
moves.text: All enemies lose 1 turn and their Defense is -50.

moves.name: She Quan Fist Combo
moves.text: Flip a coin 9x. Does 50 for each heads and 25 for each tails.

moves.name: Gold Aurum Discs

cards.ability: All enemies lose 15 Life whenever they do a damage attack to Godiva, for as long as Godiva is alive. (Ignores Defense.)

cards.name: Addie

moves.name: Chemical Elephant Husk
moves.text: 1st turn does 75 to one enemy. Next turn heal Adyuvar by 75 and does 50 to all enemies.

moves.name: Censorship
moves.text: One enemy is unable to use one move (their choice) for the remainder of the battle.

moves.name: Abdominal Maw
moves.text: For the next 2 opponent turns, track total damage done to Adyuvar. On the player's next turn, deal that damage + 300 to all enemies.

cards.ability: At the start of the match, for the first 4 opponent turns all damage done to Adyuvar is halved. When her Life drops below 100, +175 to move number 1 for the remainder of the match.
cards.flavorText: Dr. Ankhet "Addie" Ram Sahwaht Adyuvar Heru. 7th Ranked VixTen Commander
cards._note: Life/Defense/PL are formulas rather than fixed numbers, printed as strings here — engine will need to compute these at match start.

cards.name: Vindrstormr

moves.name: Violent Gale
moves.text: Does 75 to all enemies.

moves.name: Storm Bringer
moves.text: Wait 1 turn. Increases Vindrstormr's, Pandorrah's, and Röykjötunn's next attack by +150 each.

moves.name: Storm Ender
moves.text: Wait 2 turns. On the 3rd turn does 200 to all enemies.

cards.ability: Once this card is played, heal Pandora (or +50 Life if already full). Once this card, Pandora, and Röykjötunn are all on the BF at the same time, +25 Defense to each.
cards.flavorText: Pandorrah's Box Summon: the Wind Monster

cards.name: Röykjötunn

moves.name: Smoke Assault
moves.text: All enemies lose one turn.

moves.name: Smoke Filled Atmosphere
moves.text: For the next 3 opponent turns, -50 from total damage; for the next 3 player turns, +25 to all damage.

moves.name: Smoke Siege
moves.text: 1st turn does 50 to all enemies. Next turn does 100 to all enemies. 3rd turn does 150 to all enemies.

cards.ability: When this card is played, heal Pandora's Life by 25. When this card, Pandora, and Vindrstormr are all on the BF at the same time, every 4 turns heal all 3 by 20 each.
cards.flavorText: Pandorrah's Box Summon: the Smoke Titan

cards.name: Pandorrah's Box

moves.name: Summon Vindrstormr
moves.text: Flip a coin 4 times. If the player flips 3 tails, they can summon Vindrstormr. If successful, Pandora can take another action this turn.

moves.name: Summon Röykjötunn
moves.text: Roll a die. If the player rolls a 2, 3, or 9, they can summon Röykjötunn. If successful, heal Pandora by 100 Life.

cards.ability: Once this card is played, +25 to Pandora's Defense. Once Vindrstormr and Röykjötunn are both on the BF, the player may take 3 actions in one turn, as long as they come from Pandora and her summons.
cards.flavorText: Pandora's Weapon

cards.name: Pandora

moves.name: Winder Blast
moves.text: Does 25 to one enemy.

moves.name: Haute Cutter
moves.text: 1st turn does 50 to all enemies. Next turn does 75 to all enemies and +5 Defense to all allies.

moves.name: Capoeira Combo
moves.text: Flip a coin 5x. Each heads does 50 to one enemy; each tails does 20 to all enemies.

cards.ability: Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 5, or 8, you can summon Pandorrah's Box (rolling the die takes up a turn). If successful, heal Pandora by 100 Life.
cards.flavorText: Pandorrah "Pandora," the 5th Ranked VixTen Commander

cards.name: Benz

moves.name: Elleh Azulu
moves.text: Does 100 to one enemy.

moves.name: Magma of Might
moves.text: 1st turn does 50 to all enemies. Next turn does 150 to all enemies and +10 to Benz's Defense.

moves.name: Molten Fury Release
moves.text: Wait 2 turns. On the 3rd turn does 200 to all enemies and resets Benz's Life to 300. The next turn does 200 to all enemies and -25 to Benz's Defense.

cards.name: Xinyu

moves.name: Telekinesis Crush
moves.text: Does 100 to all enemies. Ignores Defense.

moves.name: Assassin Ambush

cards.name: Water Titan

cards.flavorText: The entire Pacific Rim will be destroyed! An ancient monster awakens!

cards.name: Seven

moves.name: Mean Uppercut
moves.text: Does 100 to one enemy. Seven loses a turn.

moves.name: Deadman Strike
moves.text: Does 50 to all enemies. Next turn does 25 to one enemy.

moves.name: Zoo Phi Furry

cards.ability: If Kio is played as an ally on the BF, +15 current Life for both and +10 damage to all moves. Your team may perform up to 3 actions per turn instead of 2.

cards.name: Li-Ola

moves.name: Dream Ruin
moves.text: +100 to all enemies' and allies' moves and Life.

moves.name: Dream Escape
moves.text: Flip a coin 10x. If 3 heads, Li-Ola goes back to the deck. If tails, -25 to enemies' Life. Bypasses Defense.

cards.flavorText: Lola "Reme," 2nd Ranked VixTen Commander. Ancient Elf
cards._note: 3 Drive revisions exist. Used the latest-created file ('Li-Ola.png'), which has no printed Ability and Life '8 turns.' Two earlier revisions ('Li-Ola 2.png', 'Li-Ola 3.png') included an Ability letting her roll a die (1/3/7) to take a Character card straight from the opponent's hand onto the BF, and a coin-flip variant of move 3 — that Ability is NOT in this version. Flag if that was dropped unintentionally, since it's a meaningful power change, not just wording.
